intervals.label: ZEPLIN-II and ZEPLIN-III operations
intervals.note: Start: ZEPLIN-II 'operational at the Boulby Mine underground laboratory since 2005' (arXiv:astro-ph/0703362); the collaboration's founding date is not published in the sources read. End: ZEPLIN-III's second science run ended in May 2011.
intervals.quote: The ZEPLIN programme reaches thus its conclusion at Boulby, having deployed and exploited successfully three liquid xenon experiments of increasing reach.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: The ZEPLIN programme is described as concluded at Boulby; the LZ experiment later followed on from ZEPLIN-III and LUX (naming) but no source read describes an organisational merger.
intervals.quote: After 319 days of data taking the second science run ended in May 2011.

name: ZEPLIN Collaboration
notes: Roster and founding date are not published in the sources read.

summary.plain: The collaboration that built and ran the ZEPLIN-II and ZEPLIN-III liquid xenon dark matter detectors in the Boulby mine in north-east England.
summary.technical: ZEPLIN Collaboration (ZEPLIN-II Collaboration in the 2007 first-results paper): UK, Russian and Portuguese institutions operating two-phase xenon detectors in the Palmer Laboratory at Boulby; the 2012 ZEPLIN-III paper states that 'The ZEPLIN programme reaches thus its conclusion at Boulby'.
